page_title: RMA 3-2 ALA | Real Madrid v Alaves 24/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) attempts to discuss the decision with Alejandro Ruiz, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
90+6' The photographers scatter as a shot from the edge of the box by Ander Guevara (Alaves) blazes well wide of the right post.
90+4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Alaves comes to nothing.

90+4' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Alaves.

90+1' What a wasted opportunity by Endrick (Real Madrid)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Antonio Sivera makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' The substitution is prepared. Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Vinicius Junior.
89' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

86' 3 - 2 It's a goal! Kike Garcia (Alaves) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Carlos Benavidez. The score is now 3:2.
85' 3 - 1 Goal! Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) volleys the ball from the edge of the box and it goes in off the bottom of the left post. Ander Guevara provided the assist. 3:1.
83' Endrick (Real Madrid) picked up a yellow card from referee.
80' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alejandro Ruiz saw the whole situation.
80' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to substitute Eder Militao and he is replaced by Jesus Vallejo (Real Madrid).
80' Substitution. Kylian Mbappe makes way for Arda Guler (Real Madrid).
77' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) takes a shot from inside the box and hits the right post!
75' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
73' Endrick (Real Madrid) shows off his amazing technique to get in front of goal by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the crossbar. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
71' Luis Garcia Plaza decides to make a substitution. Asier Villalibre will be replaced by Kike Garcia (Alaves).
71' Substitution. Manu Sanchez leaves the pitch and is replaced by Adrian Pica (Alaves).
71' Hugo Novoa Ramos (Alaves) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
70' The attendance for today's match is 67480.
69' Carlo Ancelotti prepares a substitution. Rodrygo is replaced by Endrick (Real Madrid).
69' Substitution. Federico Valverde is replaced by Luka Modric (Real Madrid).
67' Jon Guridi (Alaves) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
63' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
60' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to make a change. Ander Guevara (Alaves) replaces Antonio Blanco.
60' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) will replace Luka Romero.
57' Luka Romero (Alaves) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
56' A dangerous looking corner kick from Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is cleared to safety by the defence.
54' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Antonio Blanco (Alaves) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the left post.
52' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the left post.
48' 3 - 0 Rodrygo (Real Madrid) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Antonio Sivera with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 3:0.
46' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Jon Guridi (Alaves) comes on the pitch for Abdel Abqar.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is flagged for offside.
45+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Madrid.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' The resulting corner from Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is cleared.
40' 2 - 0 Goal! A great through ball by Jude Bellingham sets up Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:0.

37' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The ball goes out of play. Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
34' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
33' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
32' Santiago Mourino (Alaves) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Alejandro Ruiz stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
32' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
31' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
30' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid).
30' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Real Madrid.
29' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
28' Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
24' 71:29 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
22' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
19' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
17' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
16' The ball is cleared after Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
13' Real Madrid are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
11' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul.
9' Alejandro Ruiz interrupts the game. One of the players from Alaves won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
7' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Luka Romero (Alaves). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
7' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Luka Romero (Alaves). The referee points to the corner flag and Alaves will take a corner.
7' Alaves quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
6' Luka Romero (Alaves) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
4' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
1' 1 - 0 Goal! Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Real Madrid will have the kick-off.
